note: Layered hero colours (docs/character-appearance-layered-spec.md). Index = CharacterAppearanceData.hairColorIndex / outfitColorIndex: never reorder, only append (saved characters keep their index; CharacterAppearanceData.HairColorCount / OutfitColorCount must match). Each colour is the BASE tone (#999999 grey of the art); HeroRecolor.shader and Tools/hero_recolor_core.py build the dark and light tones from it. RO Soft Fantasy tones (user 19/11): warm, light, softly saturated, from the style board (mint #48B6A5, sky #78B7F0, coral #E46C77, gold #F4C66A); no pure black, no neon.
